tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Deep aubergine night: the base under the sky gradient and behind loading screens.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Plum glass: cards, list groups, segmented track, tab bar. Cream text on it stays above 11:1 over the sky.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Text and date fields, place results: nearly opaque so stars never sit behind typed text.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: Gold-tinted hairline edge of glass cards, the tab bar and ornaments. Decorative only.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Solid warm plum: bottom sheets, menus, pressed rows. Cream text 13:1.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Mauve control borders: inputs, secondary buttons, chips. 4.7:1 on fields, 4.4:1 on glass.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Hairlines between list rows and sections. Decorative only.

tokens.name: pomegranate
tokens.usage: Rose: primary fills (with gradient-primary), selected segment. Cream text 4.6:1. Fills only, never text on dark.

tokens.name: pomegranate-pressed
tokens.usage: Wine: primary button while pressed. Cream text 6.5:1.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Apricot gold: selection, links, focus, line ornaments, glyphs, harmonious aspects. 10:1 on bg, 7:1 on glass.

tokens.name: gold-pressed
tokens.usage: Gold text buttons while pressed.

tokens.name: ivory
tokens.usage: Warm cream: primary text and icons on every surface.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text. 7.4:1 on glass, 8.6:1 on sheets.

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and timestamps only. 5.2:1 on fields.

tokens.name: lavender
tokens.usage: Neutral chart elements and icons. 6.2:1 on glass.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on gold fills.

tokens.name: disabled-fill
tokens.usage: Background of disabled buttons and chips.

tokens.name: disabled-text
tokens.usage: Text of disabled controls (exempt from contrast rules).

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Errors and tense aspect lines (square, opposition). 9.1:1 on bg. Always pair errors with an icon and words.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Success confirmations only (saved, purchase restored). Not used in the chart.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the screen behind a bottom sheet or dialog.

tokens.name: wheel-night
tokens.usage: Planet ring of the chart wheel.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: Bright stars in the background.

tokens.name: star-dim
tokens.usage: Faint stars in the background.

tokens.name: glow-gold
tokens.usage: Apricot nebula glow (“Sunset Glow”).

tokens.name: glow-pomegranate
tokens.usage: Rose nebula glow (“Rose Dusk”).

tokens.name: glow-lavender
tokens.usage: Violet nebula glow (“Aurora Violet”).

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The Ameesi name on the first screen and the share card. Only there.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Onboarding and empty-state headlines. One per screen.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: With your Sun in Leo, you feel most yourself when you can create and share your warmth.
styles.usage: Explanations and paragraphs. Never smaller for interpretation text.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Your core self and sense of purpose

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Small section labels above content. Latin and Cyrillic only: write Armenian labels in sentence case without letter spacing.

styles.name: glyph-lg
styles.usage: Planet glyph in bottom sheets and the large row icon.

styles.name: glyph
styles.usage: Glyphs on the chart wheel and in list rows. Always add U+FE0E so phones don't draw emoji.

tokens.name: gradient-sky
tokens.usage: Deep cosmos to rose dusk: the sky behind every screen, top to bottom.

tokens.name: gradient-primary
tokens.usage: Rose to wine: primary buttons and the selected segment. Cream text 4.6:1 and 6.5:1.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a glyph and its label; icon padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; between a title and its subtitle.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of list rows and chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margins and card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Bottom-sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top of a screen to its first heading; onboarding spacing.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target height and width.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Input fields, small badges, segmented-control segments.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: List groups and row highlights.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, tab-bar highlight.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, wheel rings, sign boundaries, house lines, MC–IC axis.

tokens.name: stroke-line
tokens.usage: Aspect lines, planet ticks, outlined cards.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: Line icons.

tokens.name: stroke-axis
tokens.usage: Ascendant–Descendant axis, focus ring, selected glyph ring.

tokens.name: dash-tense
tokens.usage: Square and opposition lines (dash, gap).

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets only. Cards stay flat.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard and switch-access focus on any control.
